params.name: active
params.description: Filter by active. True: active only, false: completed only, omit: both

params.name: search_type
params.description: Filter by Search Type. Omit: all

params.name: start
params.description: Filter by start. Later than or equal if provided or omit for all before end

params.name: end
params.description: Filter by end. Earlier than or equal if provided or omit for all before start

params.name: file_size
params.description: Filter by file size. Greater than or equal if provided or omit for all file sizes (kilobytes). Overrides active to be false.

params.name: result_count
params.description: Filter by result count. Greater than or equal if provided or omit for all result counts. Overrides active to be false.

params.name: query_duration
params.description: Filter by query duration (millis). Greater than or equal if provided or omit for any duration

params.name: error_condition
params.description: Filter by queries with an error condition. Ignored if filtering for active queries. True: must have error, false: must not have error, omit: both

items.docs:
List searches, optionally filtering by: active, type (ephemeris, data_product, conjunction), between start/end, file_size >=, result_count >=, query_duration >=, has error_condition
